title: Hieroglyphics reported at historical UFO crashes
place_text: Roswell, New Mexico; Socorro, New Mexico; Kecksburg, Pennsylvania

tellings.quote: So like you have Lonnie Zamora in ' 64. You have you know um Roswell in 47 of course you have a lot of these rumors that you know hieroglyphics are on the I think Kexsburg in ' 65 also were hieroglyphics as well.

plain: Several famous UFO cases are rumoured to have involved strange writing like hieroglyphics on the craft: Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, the sighting by a man named Lonnie Zamora at Socorro, New Mexico, in 1964, and Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, in 1965. Michels lists these himself, calling them rumours and naming no source. He brings them up because the same markings turning up again and again would tie the cases together.
